verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Sentry documents an official CLI at docs.sentry.io/cli/, so the product ships one. Nothing in the pack describes what the CLI can do or how it fits AI-native or agentic workflows. missing for 10: documented CLI commands and capabilities, evidence of agent or AI-native usage (e.g. machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
